summary: Comprehensive regression testing for GROUPE YAMA+ e-commerce platform. Tested Dashboard Analytics (only counting cod_pending and paid orders), Category-based shipping calculation, Product variants for Climatiseur (Puissance CV) and Matelas (Dimensions), Featured/New products sorting, PayDunya payment integration, and Subcategory filtering. All backend tests pass (23/23). All frontend tests pass (17/17).

dashboard_analytics.details: Dashboard stats API correctly counts only cod_pending and paid orders for revenue. Pending/failed orders tracked separately.

category_based_shipping.details: Shipping calculation works correctly: Décoration/Mobilier (15K-25K), Électroménager (10K-25K), Automobile (no delivery), Immobilier (no delivery), Standard (1.5K-5K)

product_variants_climatiseur.details: ProductFormModal shows 'Activer les variantes (Puissance CV)' option when category=electromenager and subcategory=Climatiseur

product_variants_matelas.details: ProductFormModal shows 'Activer les variantes (Dimensions)' option when category=decoration and subcategory=Literie & Matelas

featured_products_sorting.details: Featured/New products have featured_order and new_order fields. Admin page allows manual sorting.

paydunya_payment.details: PayDunya payment methods endpoint returns Wave, Orange Money, Card, Free Money, Expresso, Djamo

subcategory_filtering.details: Category pages display subcategory filter buttons (Climatiseur, Réfrigérateur, Salons, Literie, Smartphones, etc.)

admin_login.details: Admin can login with admin@yamaplus.com / Admin123!

admin_dashboard.details: Dashboard shows revenue (1,821,000 FCFA), orders (8), products (16), clients (6)

checkout_flow.details: Checkout page shows shipping form, order summary, and payment methods

context_for_next_testing_agent: All major features tested and working. Dashboard analytics correctly counts only paid/cod_pending orders. Category-based shipping rules implemented for Décoration/Mobilier (higher rates), Électroménager (medium rates), Automobile/Immobilier (no delivery). Product variants UI shows correctly for Climatiseur (Puissance CV) and Matelas (Dimensions). PayDunya payment integration working. Subcategory filters visible on category pages.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. All features working as expected.
